title: BedWars preview opens at the Cookie Colosseum
summary: Coming soon: a limited production preview of four-team BedWars with bakery-cookie generators, native Java and Bedrock shops, and a purpose-built floating arena.
body:
- BedWars is tagged Coming Soon while this limited production preview is tested and may be temporarily disabled.
- Protect your team's bed, bridge between floating bakery islands, and eliminate every rival team.
- Your base generator produces match-scoped cookies and golden crumbs; diamond and emerald islands unlock stronger gear and permanent team upgrades.
- Cookie Colosseum is a rotationally balanced arena with four bakery bases, neutral sugar islands, broad cross-platform routes, and a central cookie-jar landmark.
- Java players use native inventory shops while Bedrock players receive native forms backed by the exact same catalog, prices, validation, and purchase rules.
- Parties stay together when a team has room, disconnected players have a 60-second reconnect window, and wins, kills, final kills, beds, coins, and XP are recorded.
